_comment: Blank template for a kitchen defaults record. Copy to kitchen-defaults.local.json OUTSIDE this public package, or keep it in a private profile location your cook points you at. Every value below is synthetic and illustrative: replace them with practices your own cook has actually confirmed. A default with no confirmation is a suggestion, and Miseform treats it as an ai proposal until the cook confirms it.

defaults.notes: Record where finished product is held. Point at the approved kitchen SOP rather than writing a temperature here; a numeric safety limit belongs to the SOP, not to this file.
Name the setpoint or the equipment that holds it, and inherit it by reference. Do not record a numeric temperature that no chef stated.
List the equipment a recipe may assume without being asked about, one entry per practice.
Record the container and label conventions the kitchen uses by default.
Name the approved SOPs a recipe may cite. A default may point at an SOP; it may never replace one or turn a policy into a number.

_safety: This record never supplies a numeric safety limit, a shelf life, an allergen status, an ingredient amount, a measured yield, or an approval.
Safety-critical facts come from the cook, from an approved SOP, or they stay unknown.
Anything the chef says about a single recipe overrides a default recorded here.
